campaign.title: The Discovery Below
campaign.subtitle: A Fulminary Prologue
campaign.description: Theron, an elven Edenite miner, learns that the stone his city sells has been holding something down. A branching prologue of family, industry and restrained horror beneath Sturmvale.
campaign.author: Fulminary Prologue Campaign Bible
campaign.content_notes: Industrial disaster, injury, illness (stormlung, deepvein), restrained supernatural horror. No on-page religious iconography, no fully visible demon.
campaign.author_notes: Converted from The_Discovery_Below_Implementation_Package.md against the CDF in docs/JOURNEY_AUTHORING.md. Canon authority: Fulminary Prologue Campaign Bible. VISUAL TASKS: every scene carries a `visual_brief` in author_notes; no asset IDs invented, background_asset intentionally omitted everywhere.

npcs.name: Theron

npcs.name: Edran
npcs.title: Stone-Cartographer

npcs.title: Mother

factions.name: Edenite Mining Commission
factions.description: Regulates extraction, quota and custody of Edenite across Fulminary.

endings.name: The Reluctant Savior
endings.spoiler_safe_label: A record that could not be buried
endings.description: Varrik lived to put his own order on the record, and the Commission could not bury the account entirely.

epilogue_blocks.content: Varrik gave his statement with one arm strapped across his chest and no softness anywhere in it. He had ordered the cut. He said so twice, so no clerk could mishear it.
Theron's warning entered the record beside the order that ignored it. It changed nothing that had already happened, and everything that could be argued afterward.

endings.author_notes: Legacy: the reluctant savior. Resolved by ending priority, not by a state variable.

endings.name: The Secret Witness
endings.description: Enough survived to prove something to the Commission, and the Commission decided who could survive knowing it.

epilogue_blocks.content: The Commission recorded an unknown subterranean event and an emergency structural intervention. Both sentences were true. Neither was honest.
Theron kept the notes. Timinny kept copies of the notes. Edran kept the map, and the map kept the ring.

endings.author_notes: Legacy: the secret witness. Resolved by ending priority, not by a state variable.

endings.name: The Disputed Savior
endings.spoiler_safe_label: An argument the miners refused to drop
endings.description: Varrik did not come back up, but the miners who did repeated both the warning and the last order.

epilogue_blocks.content: The surviving crew told it in the same order every time: the warning first, then the gate, then the foreman who held it. Told often enough, a story becomes a kind of evidence, though never the kind a commission accepts.

endings.author_notes: Legacy: the disputed savior. Resolved by ending priority, not by a state variable.

endings.name: Unauthorized Interference
endings.spoiler_safe_label: A record written by the Commission
endings.description: Crownvein failed, the city stood, and the record named the man who went down instead of the men who kept cutting.

epilogue_blocks.content: Crownvein failed after unauthorized interference with Commission property. That was the sentence, and it was filed, and it was never corrected.
History happens regardless. Records simply take longer.

endings.author_notes: Legacy: unauthorized interference. Lowest-priority fallback ending attached to S15.

scenes.title: A Roof That Remembers
scenes.subtitle: Bethella's home, before dawn
scenes.author_notes: Fixed event: family established. visual_brief: A modest elven home in Sturmvale before dawn. Pale stone, dark timber, narrow windows, faintly luminous Edenite braces in repaired roof joints. Theron secures a mining satchel; Edran studies rolled mine maps; Bethella sits beneath a blanket, alert but affected by stormlung. Threatening clouds beyond the glass. No demonic imagery. ASSET UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: The roof always knew the storm before the sky did.
Its oldest beams complained first, a low wooden groan above the kitchen. Then pale light passed through the Edenite braces Theron had fitted into the western joints last winter.
Outside, Sturmvale remained dark and almost peaceful. Chimney smoke rested above the lower streets. The clouds gathered without wind.
At the table, Edran had managed to bury breakfast beneath three survey rolls and a badly folded elevation map. Bethella watched both sons while pretending to watch neither.
The western brace flashed again.
It likes attention.
You installed it.
Which is how I know.
You said it would last through winter.
It did.
It is summer.
Then we exceeded expectations.
Bethella's laugh becomes a shallow cough. Theron crosses to her and checks the small Edenite setting in the clasp at her collar. Its light is fading.
Do not start fussing.
I have not started. This is the quiet preparation before the fussing.
Timinny is teaching you bad habits.
Timinny taught him to label his bad habits.
Bethella catches Theron studying the fading stone.

choices.choice_text: "I will bring home enough for a proper setting. No scraps this time."
"If the roof comes down, Edran's maps can tell us where it landed."
"The charge is building faster than it should. Stay away from the western wall today."

scenes.title: The Things Stone Can Do
scenes.subtitle: Timinny's workshop
scenes.author_notes: Fixed event: grounding behaviour first observed. Includes the S01 tone payoff, the map setup and the treatment beat. visual_brief: A crowded engineering workshop of bridge models, stone braces, copper leads and mineral samples; Timinny in a rugged self-built wheeled chair; Theron kneeling at a miniature stone arch braced by three blue-white Edenite fragments; storm-dark window backlight. ASSET UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: Bring yourself home. We can negotiate with the roof.
Approximately.
Both of you inherited that from someone, and it was not me.
Then say you are worried. Instructions are not the same thing.
I am worried.
Theron notices the crest on Edran's top survey: CROWNVEIN — LOWER EXPANSION.
That should not be here.
Good morning to you too.
Crownvein surveys do not leave the EMC archive.
Training copy. Old measurements, no extraction marks. I have to reconcile the western descent.
Theron studies a pale, blank curve inside the lower strata.
What is this?
Bad ink.
Ink usually has the decency to exist.
A copying omission. Every survey has one.
You will miss Timinny.
Theron releases the map.
Keep this one out.
Why?
It has bad ink.
Theron steps into the cold morning. Somewhere beneath the western streets, something strikes stone three times. He stops. The sound does not repeat.
Timinny's workshop contained three kinds of object: things that worked, things that might work, and things he insisted had been ruined by someone else's measurements.
Theron finds him beneath a suspended bridge model, tightening a copper contact from his chair.
You are late.
I am early for tomorrow.
That joke was tired when I still walked.
You laughed then.
I could leave the room then.
Theron sets a wrapped fragment on the table. Timinny's expression changes when he sees its unusual density.
That is not waste stone.
It was going to become waste.
Everything becomes waste if you steal it badly enough.
Timinny directs Theron to place the fragment into a three-point brace around a cracked model tower. A copper vane carries static from the workshop roof.
The discharge strikes. Instead of merely strengthening the crack, the Edenite pulls the charge sideways. Pale light passes through all three points and grounds into the stone base.
It moved.
Energy moves.
Not like that.
No. Not like that.
Timinny rotates the fragment with a tool. A dark thread lies within its glow.
Where did you get this?

choices.choice_text: "The Crown. New western face. It warmed before the thunder last shift. I took it before Varrik counted the cut."

effects.notice: Timinny knows where the stone came from.

choices.choice_text: "A discarded cut. I noticed the dark thread after I brought it out."
"Are we examining my employment or the impossible thing the stone just did?"

scenes.title: The New Cut
scenes.subtitle: Crownvein Mine
scenes.author_notes: Fixed event: Theron assigned to Crownvein. Opens with the treatment beat that closes S02. visual_brief: An immense mine staging floor with timber lifts, carved supports, wet rails, suspended lamps and carts of luminous Edenite; the EMC crest above the primary lift; Varrik broad and severe in a foreman's coat. ASSET UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: Stones do not return themselves.
This one might.
Your gift for precision remains unmatched.
Both. One may kill you before the other.
Timinny's hand trembles as he checks the Edenite housing beside his hip. Its core is almost colorless.
How long?
Four days.
You said ten.
I was younger when I said it.
That was yesterday.
A difficult night.
Theron separates a small shaving from the fragment and fits it into Timinny's treatment housing, over his objection that the piece is evidence of something they cannot yet name.
Record everything at the Crown. Heat, vibration, position. Do not decide what it means before it happens.
And if Varrik asks why I am measuring instead of cutting?
Tell him an engineer ordered it.
Are you an EMC engineer?
No.
Then that seems unlikely to help.
As Theron leaves, the covered fragment flashes in time with thunder that has not yet sounded.
Crownvein Mine was less than a year old and already too important to fail.
Varrik stands beside the tally board, finding fault with the speed of workers who have not begun.
Theron.
Theron stops.
When a foreman says a name, the expected answer is not a demonstration of stillness.
I did not want to interrupt.
You were assigned to the western face because someone above me mistook patience for talent. You will cut, load, and keep your clever hands out of your pockets.
In that order?
Quota is doubled before the storm arrives.
Doubled because of the storm?
The retaining walls need reinforcement. The infirmaries need treatment stone. Every frightened councilor has learned what keeps his ceiling above him.
And removing twice as much from beneath it?
Is the work.

choices.choice_text: "Understood."
"The western braces are carrying a vibration that is not on the load chart."
"If the ceiling comes down, I will count whatever lands in the carts."

scenes.title: The Last Ordinary Shift
scenes.subtitle: The western extraction face
scenes.author_notes: Fixed events: first anomaly, mine collapse. visual_brief: An immense curving vein of luminous Edenite dominating a deep gallery; one miner down near the vein; Theron between the wounded worker, a dark-threaded fragment and a fissure producing impossible knocks. Three visibly competing priorities. ASSET UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: Then swing between vibrations.
If the ceiling comes down, your replacement will count it.
The lift descends. At the western face, Edenite forms a nearly continuous luminous arc through the wall and floor. Theron touches a support. The vibration comes in threes. Varrik signals the cut.
The first strike lands. Every lamp dims. Far beyond the exposed face, something answers.
The quota turns the gallery into noise. Beneath steel, carts, and shouted weights, Theron hears three impacts, a pause, and three more.
The sound comes from behind the Edenite.
An extraction wedge splits the arc. Thunder rolls through the gallery. Only afterward does it sound aboveground.
Stop cutting.
The next tool head flashes white and fractures. A shard tears across a miner's thigh.
Blood touches raw Edenite. The wound closes, then opens again along branching lines that do not follow the original cut.
A dark-threaded fragment falls near Theron. The knocking accelerates. The miner begins losing consciousness. Varrik orders the crew to secure the face.

choices.choice_text: Drag the miner away from the vein and bind the original wound.
choices.description: Theron reaches the wounded man first. The fragment and the fissure will have to wait.

choices.choice_text: Wrap the dark-threaded fragment before its glow fades.
choices.description: Other miners will move the wounded man. The delay will cost him.

choices.choice_text: Set a marking spike against the fissure and trace the knocking.
choices.description: Each knock moves toward the spike until the metal taps by itself.

scenes.title: A Room Without an Entrance
scenes.subtitle: Beneath Crownvein
scenes.author_notes: Fixed event: unmapped space exposed. visual_brief: An ancient-looking void exposed behind luminous stone, not a constructed temple. Smooth black boundaries interrupting natural strata; scorched mineral veins like roots; Theron among collapse debris with one or two miners; weak sickly Edenite glow. No recognizable religious symbols, no fully visible demon. ASSET UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: The C02 aftermath: Varrik orders everyone away from the face.
Away from the face.
Order the lift.
You do not give orders.
Then borrow mine.
The entire Edenite arc goes dark. Something enormous presses against the other side of the stone. The western face folds inward. Theron falls through blue light and black dust.
When he wakes, his lamp burns inside a room with no entrance. Edran's voice whispers through the wall.
Theron?
Edran is miles away.

Theron rises in a chamber that should have been solid. The walls are neither cut nor natural. Stone appears to have drawn away from a central emptiness. Scorched veins reach outward, stopping wherever intact Edenite remains.
The wrapped fragment pulls toward the black wall.
Theron immediately recognizes the exposed boundary as the edge he traced.
The wounded miner's words repeat in Theron's memory: something under it.
A trapped miner calls from beneath a fallen brace. Another lamp moves in a side hollow.
Theron. You left me below.
Edran does not sound that dramatic.
The voice shifts into Bethella's cough.
Miners had already withdrawn from the immediate face before the collapse; the chamber contains fewer trapped workers.
The collapse caught the full face crew. The injuries in the dark are worse than anything Theron can count from here.

choices.choice_text: Follow the airflow, not the voice. Free the trapped miner.
Follow the scorched veins to where the black boundary meets a fresh extraction line.

scenes.title: The Living Route
scenes.author_notes: Branch of C03-A; reconverges at S07 after one scene. visual_brief: optional — a narrow break in collapsed stone, cold air, lamp light on a hand-like impression forming inside solid rock. ASSET UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: Theron wedges a broken support beneath the trapped stone.
Leave me. The wall is moving.
Walls are slow. You are complaining quickly. I favor our chances.
He frees the miner and follows cold air through a narrow break. Behind them, the impossible chamber collapses, burying most visible proof.
The rescued miner sees a hand-like impression form briefly inside solid rock.
I saw it.
Remember that when someone important tells you otherwise.

scenes.title: The Hollow Pattern
scenes.author_notes: Branch of C03-B; reconverges at S07 after one scene. visual_brief: optional — notebook geometry sketched by lamplight, scorched paths ending at intact Edenite. ASSET UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: Theron scratches the chamber geometry into Timinny's notebook. Every scorched path ends at intact Edenite. Every opening aligns with an extracted section above.
Record everything.
Theron holds his lamp closer. A shape moves where no space exists.
A cry cuts through the chamber. Theron returns to the trapped miner, but the shifting brace has crushed one leg. Theron frees him, unable to undo the injury.
You were right there.
Theron has no answer that helps.

scenes.title: Lines That Should Meet
scenes.subtitle: Bethella's home, that night
scenes.author_notes: Fixed event: Edran maps barrier geometry. visual_brief: Night inside the family home; mine dust still on Theron; Edran overlaying official surveys with Theron's rough chamber sketch; Bethella nearby as rain intensifies; luminous map lines forming a broken underground ring. ASSET UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: Bethella cleans a cut above Theron's brow.
The EMC messenger said equipment failure.
Equipment did fail.
Theron.
The wall failed first.
Edran studies Theron's sketch, turning it twice.
The sketch is thin — a shape remembered while running.
The notebook pages are dense with measured angles, taken while a man was still trapped behind him.
This bend is wrong.
The room is wrong.
Rooms can be badly made. Stone cannot occupy this angle and still meet the western descent.
It does not meet it. It surrounds it.

Edran overlays the old Crownvein survey. The blank curve joins Theron's chamber line. Together they suggest a wide ring of dense Edenite around a central void. New extraction marks have cut through it.

choices.choice_text: "You have enough to correct the map. Leave the rest to me."
"Something spoke from the wall. It used your voice. The missing curve is not an error."
"I have been taking fragments. Timinny and I have tested them. Something below used your voice."

scenes.title: Grounding the Storm
scenes.subtitle: Timinny's workshop, heavy rain
scenes.author_notes: Fixed event: Timinny helps prove grounding. Opens with the C04 payoff and Bethella's question from S07. visual_brief: The workshop during heavy rain; Edran's ring map beneath a circular arrangement of Edenite fragments and copper contacts; Timinny directing from his chair; dark motion inside one fragment; electrical light bending through the ring. ASSET UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: You came home speaking around every answer.
What was behind it?
Good. I was worried you had developed a sensible reason.
If that stone was holding something down, why would the Council order you to remove it?
Because no one told them it was holding anything.
We are telling them now.
Lightning silently illuminates the windows.
Timinny compares the ring map to the three-point model.
He has already recreated Theron's observations and begins as a full collaborator.
He asks Theron to demonstrate each claimed behavior before accepting the ring model.
He confronts Theron for withholding the fragment's origin before agreeing to continue.
A brace carries weight because every point agrees where the weight should go.
The seam was not ore.
It was ore. That is why this is difficult. A thing can be useful and still have a purpose before we touch it.
Edran has left the copied map but is absent.
It is not flat. The northern edge rises toward Sturmvale.
Like a channel.
Or a circuit.

They place fragments at the mapped elevations. Timinny charges the model. The first attempt cracks a support. The second sends charge into the wrong wall. Theron rotates the darkest fragment so its natural grain points back toward the ring.
On the third attempt, light travels around the entire model and grounds through the base. The storm outside weakens for one breath.
Then every fragment turns toward Theron.
Open.

choices.choice_text: Knock the central contact free.
Keep a hand on the contact while Timinny records the flow.

scenes.title: A Miner Before the Commission
scenes.subtitle: EMC hearing chamber
scenes.author_notes: Fixed event: Orsik rejects warning. Opens with the S08 risk payoff. visual_brief: A severe administrative chamber of polished dark stone, EMC insignia, quota ledgers and guarded Edenite displays; Theron dusty and plainly dressed before elevated officials; Orsik controlled and socially distant, never overtly monstrous. ASSET UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: Sensible.
Do not sound disappointed.
The word OPEN repeated through Theron's bones until Timinny shouted him off the contact. A faint branching burn remains on his palm.
The ring did not strengthen the model.
It told the force where to go.
Crownvein cut through the instructions.
Then take the Council evidence before Varrik removes the rest.
A miner corroborates the impossible wall, then becomes uncertain under questioning.
The fragment reacts to the chamber's stored Edenite. Orsik frames it as contaminated stolen material.
Theron presents his sketches and Edran's map. Officials call them interpretations rather than proof.
Timinny's measurements demonstrate abnormal grounding. They do not demonstrate demons.
Theron discloses the experiments himself, before Orsik can unveil them for dramatic advantage.
Orsik reveals the custody discrepancy without warning and takes control of the hearing.
The injured miner appears as a witness, thin and upright and stubborn about what he felt pull at him.
Orsik cites the man's condition as evidence that Theron delayed the rescue or mishandled the scene.
I was there. I chose the wall over the man. Say the rest of it, Commissioner, and I will not contradict you.
You are asking the Commission to close the most productive mine in Fulminary because a wall spoke using your brother's voice.
I am asking you to stop cutting until you understand what the Edenite was doing underground.
We understand it well enough to heal your injured men, brace your mother's roof, and keep half this city standing.
Then understand why the storms worsen every time the carts grow heavier.
Correlation spoken confidently is still correlation.
And a collapse called equipment failure is still a collapse.
Varrik or an EMC clerk presents the custody discrepancy.
You have removed undeclared Edenite from Crownvein.
Yes.
Repeatedly.
Yes.
You conducted unauthorized experiments with an unlicensed engineer and now present the results as cause to halt national production.
The results remain true regardless of how little you think of the people who found them.
That sentence is the first evidence you have provided against anything other than yourself.
Orsik refuses a shutdown. Extraction will continue under EMC inspection.

choices.choice_text: "Send your inspectors. Let me show them the chamber before another cut is made."
"If you will not stop the cut, the workers deserve the truth."
"Its purpose was to determine whether the facts were expensive."

scenes.title: Under Watch
scenes.author_notes: Branch of C05-A; reconverges at S11 after one scene. visual_brief: optional — an EMC side chamber, storm readings climbing on a wall gauge. ASSET UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: Theron waits in an EMC side chamber as storm readings climb. The floor vibrates in groups of three.
Edran arrives with the completed ring survey and forces a clerk to compare it to fresh subsidence reports.
Timinny sends a mechanical recorder carrying a repeated charge spike from Crownvein.
An official opens the door.
Commissioner Veyr has authorized your transfer to the mine.
Transfer?
He did not say release.

scenes.title: The Bell Without Leave
scenes.author_notes: Branch of C05-B; reconverges at S11 after one scene. visual_brief: optional — the shift bell, miners gathering in confusion, guards arriving late. ASSET UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: Theron reaches the shift bell before EMC guards reach him. He sounds the emergency pattern. Miners gather in confusion.
The western face is unstable. Stay out of the lower cut until the ring is inspected.
You do not command this mine.
Then command them somewhere safer.
Some miners obey Theron because of the earlier collapse. Others wait for Varrik.
Varrik remembers Theron's earlier warning and pauses the deepest crew, while publicly condemning him for the bell.

scenes.title: Back Through the Rain
scenes.author_notes: Branch of C05-C; reconverges at S11 after one scene. visual_brief: optional — copper leads, setting hammers and survey pins gathered by lamplight while rain hammers the workshop roof. ASSET UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: Theron and Timinny gather copper leads, setting hammers, survey pins, and every usable Edenite remnant in the workshop.
Edran works beside them, marking elevations as they are packed.
This is not a device. It is an argument made from scrap.
The Commission preferred the other kind.
Edran discovers the plan and insists on bringing the missing elevation map.
You can protect me after we survive.

scenes.title: Sturmvale Bends
scenes.author_notes: Fixed event: storm and breach unify. Protected-character rule: Bethella survives. visual_brief: Sturmvale under a supernatural storm; blue-white charge crawling through structural Edenite; stone buildings bending or fracturing; Theron and Edran moving Bethella toward shelter; Timinny navigating rain-slick streets in his engineered chair; the storm centred beneath the city rather than above it. ASSET UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: The storm arrives from below.
Every Edenite brace in Sturmvale flashes at once. Charge climbs walls, leaps between roofs, and returns toward Crownvein.
Bethella collapses as stormlung steals her breath. Theron supports her while Edran clears a route.
Go to the mine.
You cannot breathe.
And you cannot lie convincingly. The mine first.
I can get her to the eastern shelter.
You do not know what is happening.
Because you decided I should not.
The ring rises beneath the shelter district. If the southern point fails, the charge comes here next.
Timinny arrives with the grounding assembly. His treatment housing flickers as the city's Edenite supply destabilizes.
Crownvein is no longer a mine. It is the break in the circuit.
Theron gets Bethella into shelter. The door holds. Whatever else this night takes, it does not take her.

scenes.title: The Descent Against Orders
scenes.author_notes: Fixed event: first incursion occurs. The two closing choices are the supported representation of the conditional VARRIK_STANCE update (shaken, or cooperative when the crew was warned); exactly one is ever available. visual_brief: Crownvein's entrance during catastrophic weather; overturned carts, crooked lifts, blue lightning travelling down into the mine; a lesser demonic form partially manifested from stone and smoke — undeniable but unstable, asymmetrical, hard to comprehend. Not a generic horned humanoid. ASSET UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: You caused panic, stole Commission stone, and returned carrying a workshop toy.
Then the day remains full of surprises.
I did not believe your ghosts. I believed the braces.
Varrik remains antagonistic, but the miners who liked Theron's humor make space for him anyway.
A miner strikes what appears to be a collapsed support.
The support unfolds.
It has no stable anatomy. Stone passes through a body made of smoke, wet sinew, and absence. It moves only where the Edenite ring has been cut.
Varrik attacks it with an extraction tool. The tool passes through until its Edenite edge flashes, forcing the creature back.
That is not a ghost.
I will try not to look pleased.
The route splits: trapped crew in the lower gallery, broken ring segments near the breach, and an unstable grounding path through the upper supports.

choices.choice_text: Take the split routes with Varrik at your shoulder.
choices.author_notes: Crew was warned at the bell: Varrik becomes cooperative.

choices.choice_text: Take the split routes while Varrik is still deciding what he saw.
choices.author_notes: Crew unwarned: Varrik is shaken rather than cooperative.

scenes.title: The First Incursion
scenes.author_notes: Fixed event: climax priority selected. visual_brief: split Crownvein galleries — a folding lower gallery, a broken luminous arc near the breach, and failing central supports strung with copper. ASSET UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: Three routes, one man, and a mine that is finished pretending to be a mine.
Below, the trapped crew. Ahead, the broken ring. Above, the grounding path that Timinny sketched and nobody has tested.

choices.choice_text: Reach the lower gallery before it folds into the breach.
choices.description: Edran's elevations give Theron a ventilation cut the maps do not show.

choices.choice_text: Return salvaged fragments to the broken arc.
choices.description: Each restored segment narrows where the entities can move.

choices.choice_text: Climb the failing central supports and lay Timinny's copper path.
choices.description: A path toward the surface discharge point, if the supports hold.

scenes.title: The Seal That Was Taken
scenes.author_notes: Fixed events: seal restored, Theron survives, stormscar created. The two closing choices are the supported representation of the conditional VARRIK_FATE resolution; exactly one is ever available. visual_brief: Theron in the impossible central chamber amid a broken circular network of Edenite; salvaged fragments, copper conductors and mine supports forming an improvised grounding system; a vast presence pressing behind thinning stone without being seen; lightning coursing through Theron, leaving branching dark mineral scars along arm and shoulder. ASSET UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: Every path reaches the central chamber. Varrik remains behind to hold a failing gate while Theron enters.
You wanted the cut stopped.
I wanted you to stop it.
Take what you can get.
Most of the lower crew came up through the ventilation cut. Some did not, and nobody had time to learn their names.
The rescue was handed to other hands while Theron worked the arc.
You build doors.
Today I am closing one.
The chamber is larger than before, because less of the barrier remains.
The Presence uses familiar voices in succession: Bethella, Edran, Timinny, then Theron's own.
They take from you. Open, and be more.
I have met important men. You sound like them.
Theron identifies three surviving ring points. The extracted Edenite in his pack is not enough to rebuild the original barrier, but it can reconnect the remaining structure.
The copper path is ready and waiting.
One connection has to be improvised with whatever came down in the pack.
There is no cable left. There is an extraction tool, and there is his body.
The northern point is higher than your position. The map was wrong.
Your map or theirs?
Theirs.
I knew I liked yours.
Do not brace against the force. Give it a path.
A path where?
Somewhere that is not us.
Theron redirects the circuit through Crownvein's central supports and toward exposed bedrock beyond Sturmvale.
The ring reconnects. Every loose fragment rises from the chamber floor and turns toward the gap. The lesser entities lose shape. The Presence strikes the barrier from below.

Theron closes the final connection with his hand. Storm charge passes through his arm, shoulder, and chest. Dark branching marks form beneath his skin. He remains conscious long enough to rotate the last fragment with its grain aligned to the ring.
The chamber contracts. The extracted galleries collapse inward, burying Crownvein's richest deposit back into the seal. The storm discharges across uninhabited western stone rather than Sturmvale.

choices.author_notes: Varrik is pulled from the failing gate with a crushed arm and survives.

scenes.title: Thunder Moving East
scenes.author_notes: Fixed events: local containment, Eden Tower insight seeded, threat moves east. The aftermath, family resolution, official resolution, Eden Tower seed and eastward-storm image are all ordinary narrative blocks so the run cannot finish before them; the ending record then adds its epilogue. visual_brief 1: a damaged but standing Sturmvale after the storm, Crownvein sealed in the distance, Theron bearing a dark branching stormscar, Edran supporting him, Bethella and Timinny rejoining them. visual_brief 2: Theron's sketch of connected elevated Edenite structures. visual_brief 3: unnatural storm clouds moving east across the continent. ASSETS UNRESOLVED.

blocks.content: You look terrible.
Accurate maps inspire confidence.
Edran grips his unscarred hand.
Varrik is carried out with a crushed arm and an expression that dares anyone to comment on it.
Varrik does not come up. The last miners through the gate describe a man who did not move from it.
Bethella touches the edge of Theron's scar without touching the darkest lines.
Does it hurt?
Only when I breathe.
Theron.
Yes.
Does it hurt?
Yes.
She rests her forehead against his.
Timinny examines Theron's notes. His deepvein treatment weakened during the disruption, but he remains stable enough to continue.
You rebuilt a continental barrier with mine scrap.
Crownvein scrap.
Stolen Crownvein scrap.
It returned itself.
Orsik meets Theron without the elevation of the hearing chamber.
The Commission will record an unknown subterranean event and an emergency structural intervention.
You saw what came out.
I saw what the public can survive knowing today.
Crownvein failed after unauthorized interference with Commission property.
He saved the city.
History requires evidence.
No. Records require evidence. History happens regardless.
Put my statement in the record. Theron warned me before the first collapse. I ordered the cut.
Orsik cannot fully bury the account.
Surviving miners repeat both Theron's warning and Varrik's final act, to anyone who will stand still for it.

Later, Theron sits in Timinny's workshop with his scarred arm supported in a sling. Edran's ring survey lies beside the three-point tower model. Theron sketches multiple elevated structures connected across a landscape.
More seals?
Not below.
Towers?
Paths. If the storm can be told where to leave one city, perhaps it can be told where not to enter any of them.
That will require more Edenite than you can fit in your pocket.
Then I will need a better pocket.
Crownvein was closed. Sturmvale stood. The High Council called the disaster contained.

Far beyond Fulminary, shepherds watched birds abandon the western sky. Wells warmed in villages that had never heard the word Edenite. Along roads leading east, travelers carried stories of thunder beneath clear weather.
Theron had closed one wound.
The land had begun to open elsewhere.
An unnatural storm front moves from west to east across the distant continent.
What was carried out of Crownvein
The seal below Sturmvale holds — locally, and only locally.
Theron carries a stormscar down his arm and shoulder.
Bethella reached shelter and breathes.
Timinny's treatment was disrupted but he is alive and still arguing.
Timinny was caught in the open streets when the charge climbed the walls, and reached shelter on his own wheels.
Varrik lives, one arm crushed.
Varrik did not come up.
The injured miner from the western face recovered.
The injured miner from the western face is in a critical bed, and the ward will not promise anything.
The miner Theron left beneath the brace lost a leg.
The warned crew came up in numbers that surprised everyone.
The crew went down unwarned, and the casualty list is longer than the record will admit.
Theron's measured notes survive.
Only a rescued man's word survives.
Whatever proof there was went down with the galleries.
Edran knows only what a map can be made to say.
Edran knows about the voice in the wall.
Edran knows all of it, theft included.
Timinny trusts Theron completely.
Timinny still checks Theron's work twice.
Timinny has not forgotten what Theron withheld.
Theron's exposure to the seam is minor.
Theron has been in the charge more often than any body should be. Something in him answers weather now.
The Commission's record will say the disaster was contained. Far to the east, the land has not read the record.
